model.name: featureManager.listFeatures
model.description: R31.8b server READ for the FeatureManager view — FeatureManager.listFeatures() scans ior:class:Feature units and returns [{uuid, name, icon, allowedUsers}]. The admin READ sibling to grantFeature/revokeFeature (already Methods on FeatureManager 9f7f345a); backs the GET /api/feature-manager thin handler that the client RbFeatureManagerDetail.mount fetches to render each Feature + its allowedUsers. Distinct + tester-gated (view lists Features+allowedUsers). Singular-chain. Architect ruling 4e713fb6b.
model.supersededNote: Superseded by the native scenario-unit itemView tree (Tron maximally-DRY reframe, R31.8 AC-featuremanager-view): Features render via the EXISTING itemView by a thin CHAIN_TYPE_CONFIG Feature entry (scenarioFwd:['allowedUsers']) -> /api/trace/children resolves allowedUsers as child nodes natively — no bespoke mount-as-list, no listFeatures API-reshape. Retired one-uuid-one-identity (kept on disk, removed from live arrays). Architect reconciliation 8916e33a5.
